podcast.title: "Roadkill" Novel
podcast.body: Kinky Friedman authored a novel titled "Roadkill," which features Ben Dorsi as a character and is set aboard Willie Nelson's tour bus, integrating the real-life roadie into a fictional narrative. "Kinky Friedman wrote a novel called Roadkill, which is set aboard Willie Nelson's tour bus. Dorsi's there."

xref.title: Musical Tributes and Literary Appearances
xref.body: Ben Dorsi was honored in song by Waylon Jennings with "Ode to Ben Dorsi," and Red Sovine released a song titled "Ben Dorsi III." He also appeared as a character in Kinky Friedman's novel "Roadkill," which is set aboard Willie Nelson's tour bus. "Well, in Jennings, we're a song about him entitled, Ode to Ben Dorsi. Red Sovine has a song called Ben Dorsi III. Kinky Friedman wrote a novel called Roadkill, which is set aboard Willie Nelson's tour bus."
